opb. Intravenous ampicillin + rifampin + ceftriaxone for 2 weeks
opc. Oral gentamicin + ceftriaxone for 4 weeks
opd. Oral amoxicillin for 6 weeks
ope. Intravenous nafcillin + rifampin for 6 weeks + gentamicin for 2 weeks
